POST /v1/chat accepted. request_id=req-7f31c8a2 session=s-4417 tenant=hary-web body=8214 chars, 1 attachment-free message, content-type application/json; charset=utf-8. Handing the turn to the graph.

Unhandled exception in the input PII redaction pass; the turn was aborted before any model call. request_id=req-7f31c8a2 session=s-4417 chars=8214 language=auto elapsed=812ms. The pasted block carries an unpaired high surrogate U+D83D immediately followed by a run of 4096 combining acute accents U+0301; NFKD normalisation expands that span to 12408 characters while the recognizer offset map is still sized for the original 8214, so the rewritten span merge indexes past the end of it. Traceback (most recent call last): File "/srv/hary/hary/transport/routes.py", line 132, in chat | File "/srv/hary/hary/graph/builder.py", line 118, in _invoke_node | File "/srv/hary/hary/graph/nodes/input_guardrail.py", line 74, in __call__ | File "/srv/hary/hary/guardrails/pii.py", line 71, in redact_pii | File "/srv/hary/hary/guardrails/pii.py", line 48, in _get_presidio | File "/srv/hary/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/presidio_analyzer/analyzer_engine.py", line 203, in analyze | IndexError: string index out of range [E_PII_SPAN_MERGE]. Module hary.guardrails.pii has no except branch around the analyser call, so the exception leaves the scanner unhandled.

Graph run req-7f31c8a2 failed at node 2 of 8 (input_guardrail). The node calls hary.guardrails.pii.redact_pii on entry and only catches GuardrailViolation, so the IndexError propagated out of it unhandled and 0 of its 6 policy checks were evaluated. No node after input_guardrail executed: conversation_context, router, agent and the shared LLM client were never entered, and the raw message was never redacted, so nothing from this turn is written to the trace store.

hary-ai returned HTTP 500 for 47 of 163 chat calls in the last minute (28.8%). Upstream body: {"error":{"code":"internal_error","request_id":"req-7f31c8a2"}} with no retry-after header. The failures are payload-correlated rather than host-correlated: all three hary-ai pods answer 500 for the same message bodies and 200 for everything else, so pulling a pod out of the load-balancer pool changes nothing.

Circuit breaker for hary-ai stays closed: the observed 5xx rate is 28.8%, under the 50% trip threshold over a 60s window, so the majority of chat traffic keeps flowing normally. Serving the fallback error card to the affected turns only; 4 of the 47 failing sessions have retried more than twice inside 60s.
chat_5xx_rate_pct=28.8 percent

Assistant panel send failed with HTTP 500 on 412 of 1430 attempts in the last five minutes (28.8%). Users who pasted a formatted block out of an external editor see 'Something went wrong, please try again'; the same users succeed on the next turn when they retype the text by hand. 118 distinct sessions affected, 6 support tickets opened in 4 minutes.

Pattern confirmed across 118 sessions: every payload containing the U+D83D + U+0301 run aborts at the same offset with [E_PII_SPAN_MERGE], and no payload without it has failed since 09:41. What this side cannot establish is which layer owns the defect: the analyser engine may be mis-sizing the offset map after NFKD expansion, or hary.guardrails.pii may simply owe it an input-validation step that rejects unpaired surrogates before the call. The engine ships no telemetry and its internal span log is not collected here, so both remain open.

Clean-input throughput unchanged: 3182 of 3182 payloads without the U+D83D + U+0301 sequence were redacted successfully in the last five minutes, p95 14ms, 61 entities masked. The failure is confined to the matching subset, which is why request volume and latency dashboards still look flat.
